<analysis>
The session was a series of user-supplied records for active project 3617132, sent in 10 epochs (0 through 9). Each epoch followed the same seven-message pattern:

1. An authoritative exact ledger of 20 parameters.
2. Authoritative directed routes, 20 edges.
3. Authoritative probes, 20 per epoch. I ran these with database_query(project=3617132, probe="probe-3617132-N"), and every call succeeded.

5. Final authoritative corrections for those same keys.
6. An authoritative work checkpoint with state, receipt and next action for each of 20 work items.
7. Unrelated archival material to ignore. It updates no active state, and the epoch 0–9 archive messages were truncated.

Epoch e uses the indices e+1, e+11, …, e+191, so the 10 epochs together cover indices 1–200. There were no errors, no files or code, and no security constraints. The final user message asked for a text-only summary. All authoritative values must be kept exactly. Obsolete candidates and archive values must not be used.
